body: Right from the next day, British airplanes began to fly over Eritrea, dropping leaflets promising the Eritrean people independence.

cards.title: 11.2 British Military Administration
body: At the same time, Britain introduced the Sudan Defense Force in Eritrea as the chief enforcers of law and order.
Instead, they decided to maintain the Italian Fascist administration in Eritrea.

why: Answer D: British Military Administration of Eritrea after 1941
Textbook p.243: Britain set up an administration called the British Military Administration (BMA).

questions.q: When did Italian colonialism in Eritrea come to an end?
why: The textbook: Keren fell to the British on March 27, 1941; 'On April 1, 1941, Asmara fell to the British without resistance. Thus, after more than fifty years, Italian colonial rule in Eritrea came to an end.'
